scope: Selected reproduced records and report translations; not independently authenticated original manuscripts

records.year_month_context: Genroku 12, month 12, supplied by report context
records.translated_content: Villagers flee to hills; waves destroy 13 houses and a fire burns 20; rice provided to 159 persons and wood sought for shelters.
records.modern_time_interpretation: Around midnight January 27-28, 1700 Gregorian; report interpretation

records.record: Moriai-ke Nikki kakitome cho, Tsugaruishi account
records.correction_basis_reported: Similar fire report and adjacent snowstorm entry also dated one month earlier than snow reports in Morioka and Hachinohe records.
records.dependence: Kuwagasaki fire is hearsay in this account, not a second direct observation of that fire.
records.reported_absence: Account says no earthquake occurred locally; not a global absence of earthquake.

records.locator: p. 86 columns 1-5; volume context pp. 84, 87; competing time readings p. 43
records.reported_time: Since about dawn of the eighth day
records.year_month_context: First word means same year and month as preceding entry, per report note; preceding entry not inspected here.
records.term_limit: Report warns that this term means unusual seas without specifying tsunami versus tide, weather or pressure effects.
records.translated_content: Water reported entering Shinjō government storehouse and other buildings; crop/field losses in Atonoura; water reaches Horidobashi along a moat near the writer.
records.reporting_limit: Some clauses explicitly relay reports; do not label all observations eyewitness testimony.
records.physical_document_context: Report reproduces water-damaged entry and volume title. Damage is not independently dated and is not proof of contact with the 1700 wave.
records.parallel_record: Mandaiki, private Tadokoro family series; report p. 84 cites librarian opinion that extant volume for 1700 is a later copy.

alternative_time_readings.reading: Dawn at start of eighth day
alternative_time_readings.relation_to_proposed_origin: Before the nominal earthquake after conversion to Japan time; conflicts with causal arrival from that origin.

alternative_time_readings.reading: Following dawn, treated as start of ninth for agreement
alternative_time_readings.relation_to_proposed_origin: After nominal origin; chronological order alone does not establish source or travel-time fit.

conditional_order_check.test: Dawn of January 27 is before noon January 27, which precedes 14:00 January 27. No exact dawn minute assigned.

records.next_test: Inspect preceding dated entry and parallel record, obtain independent linguistic review of day-boundary usage, and test source-time alternatives without forcing agreement.

calendar_check.note: Executed Gregorian date addition using source anchor and month length; tests arithmetic only. Genroku 12 has intercalary ninth month in the report.

earthquake_time_inference.uncertainty: Report allows an earlier earthquake if reported flooding lagged the leading wave by one to two hours; no new confidence interval computed.
earthquake_time_inference.other_document_ambiguity: Tanabe p. 86 reproduction now visually checked: dawn-of-eighth wording retained. See Tanabe record for literal-versus-following-dawn branches and conditional causal-order conflict.
